reviews.title: I will avoid in future
reviews.text: Very late. Very dirty - or rather, they just didn't clean the plane. No apologies. Reached Gatwick airport with limited methods of getting home. I will avoid their service in future. And every time I see their adverts, I'm reminded of how awful my experience was and then looking at reviews from other people, I realised it was my fault for not checking reviews first.
reviews.author: GemmaBlackUK

reviews.title: Surely Vueling Could Do Better
reviews.text: This particular flight was not one of V's bargains, and so it was especially annoying when (1) the flight attendants were so cold they could have frozen standing water, (2) they positioned their drink carts in such a way that they blocked access to both front and rear WCs for nearly 40 minutes and were miffed when people needed to get to a bathroom while they were serving from their carts at glacial pace, (3 their weird new way of unloading the plane 5 rows at a time made it difficult for some people in the back half to make their next flights. Oh, and did I mentioned how conned the people on my row felt when the More Space seats they had paid for had no More Space that any other seat on the plane. Or that it's impossible to reach anyone at Vueling by any click-option offered on their website.
reviews.author: Fred193

reviews.title: Couldn't have asked for more
reviews.text: After reading reviews over the last month, I was not looking forward to using Vueling. I expected the worst and got the opposite. Checked in online with printed passes, all good. Made sure luggage was within limited, so all was well there. Only took what we were allowed as cabin bags (underneath bag). Flight was on time, left on time, and arrived on time. Even disembarking was done in an orderly fashion. Staff are all really friendly and helpful. It is a budget airline, so don't expect first-class treatment. Would not hesitate to use it again.
reviews.author: Christine L
reviews.route: London - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: A very basic flying experience - fine as long as everything's going okay
reviews.text: I'd never heard of Vueling before booking as part of a package deal - they had the best prices for flight times that suited. The online check-in process was quite easy however the booking management page was a bit confusing - it was never fully clear whether the ATPs for travel to Spain were completed correctly as the passport details section always indicated it was 'not filled in', depsite the information being recorded there and the site allowing the printing of boarding passes. I spent an entire morning trying to get through to Vueling's customer service to query the matter but never got anywhere with it (I just ended up in an automated loop of doom). In the end I took a chance on it probably being okay and it turns out it was. The airport experience travelling from Gatwick to BCN was no hassle; self check-in worked a dream and the flight was on time. On board was very basic, probably even more so than Easyjet, but that doesn't matter for a couple of hours. The return journey from Barcelona was more complicated. Self check-in machines wouldn't work for hold luggage but this wasn't flagged up before starting so time was spent queueing up unnecessarilly at the machines. There was no information available about what to do instead so we had to find someone working for Iberia who could help with working out which desk we were meant to go to check in the 'old fashioned way'. Then, by the time the gate number was announced there was relatively little time to get through passport control and to the gate, and once we got there (with about 10 minutes to go until the scheduled departure time) there was a hold up with the shuttle buses from gate to plane so we couldn't even get on a shuttle until the time the plane was meant to be leaving. This is perhaps more of a fault with El Prat airport than Vueling, and luckily the flight was delayed by 40 minutes, but there was no communication from Vueling to let passengers know that the flight was still on the tarmac, which would have alievieated a lot of the concern shared by the passengers left in limbo. Overall I'd be hesitant to book with Vueling again but wouldn't rule it out completely. They get you from A to B but communication is poor and customer service seems non-existant. I'm glad we didn't have significant problems with the flights as I suspect it would have been a nightmare to get sorted. But you get what you pay for and they had the best price to stay within budget for our trip.
reviews.author: Fabs_C

reviews.title: great value
reviews.text: Was slightly worried about flying with Vueling after reading some of the negative reviews but the truth is we had a great flight Flying from Gatwick to Rome on a tuesday morning check in / bag drop was quick and easy. Plane was clean, staff were friendly and although space in economy seats is always tight at 5.11 tall i wasnt cramped at all. Bags came through at Rome airport within a short time no problems at all. flying back was much the same experience apart from check in took a little longer in Rome but only a few minutes
reviews.author: shaun freestone

reviews.title: total ignorance and customer despisal
reviews.text: i have three return tickets on hand purchased three years ago. vueling canceled those flights and issued vouchers to refund after three years. now i has tried to request the refund, but they just keep ignoring my requests.
reviews.author: alexander

reviews.title: Horrible start to the holiday.
reviews.text: Horrible start to the holiday! We are a family of 4; 2 adults,2children. The night before our flight we checked in online. The site wanted us to prebook our seats for almost £50 each so we left that part. On arrival at Gatwick -they put all our luggage through and all was fine. I said to the staff member, ‘Are we sitting together?’ The response was, ‘You will find out at the gate when you board.’ We thought this was strange but didn’t think much of it. At the gate and about to board, one of the staff said to us if we could wait at the side…. we queried why, but he said to give him a minute. Later on he came over and calmly as you like, said are you ok to ‘split fly 3/1?’ We assumed he meant 3 seated together and one separately so said fine. 5 minutes later he said he wanted to confirm that we were ok with 3 of us flying now and one at a different time!!!! What?!?!? It took me some time to process what the hell was going on. Of course we complained and said we booked this flight 6 months ago and you have checked us in as a family but all the staff looked incredulous. Apparently this goes on ALL the time - even if we had prebooked seats, another member of staff said Vueling change the size of the plane last minute. Last week 40 people didn’t get on!!! It was an absolute headache and all we got was here’s an email address to complain to. Staff are unsympathetic, I think because this is what the airline does so frequently it has become the norm for them. Luckily someone cancelled last minute so we were told- ‘you’re on!’ Like we should be grateful …..never should have happened in the first place so NEVER again!
reviews.author: APL563

reviews.title: Terrible! Can’t describe these people’s incompetence in other words
reviews.text: Lost a baggage in a direct flight. Definitely won’t be flying with this airline again. Gets you wondering how is it possible for them to lose so much luggage- someone is apparently not doing their job right.
reviews.author: Μπέττυ Λ

reviews.title: Hard case luggage surcharge - disabled discrimination
reviews.text: Travelled with small hard shell suitcase that fitted under seat from London to Asturias with no problem. Travelling back, at boarding gate they surcharged me £60 at Asturias stating that charge was for hard case, objected that as it was not a soft backpack and would not squash to fit. Actual suitcase was 40×30×20 but I did not include wheels. Picture with size 6 flipflop for comparison. I am disabled, carrying luggage in a backpack is difficult and this is discrimination. Several other passengers were also surcharged. Forced to pay or would have removed suitcase which had my medication in it. Beware.
reviews.author: Pamela M

reviews.title: Pretty smooth
reviews.text: I was a bit skeptical at first because I didn't knew much about this airline. I flew from Milano Malpensa (MXP) to (BCN) in Barcelona and it went pretty smoothly. The aircraft that I flew with was an A320 and it was quiet smaller compare to I usually go with, but considering the distance, it was more than enough. The seats were standard and the leg room space was ok. There was obviously no mini monitors on them and the only thing that they could provide were snacks and wifi which you need to pay for both (optional). I was a bit dissappointed that the Wifi needed to be rented for a fee. Overall it is cheap and could get you to your destination and I highly reccomend it for families.
reviews.author: John Charles Marasigan

reviews.title: Please please read the reviews
reviews.text: This company represents a new low for customer service. There are literally no live agents. You will spend hours going around in circles, pushing buttons and getting nowhere. They moved my flight to another day and there is nothing I can do about it as I missed the change of day, and only clocked the time change. So they will happily keep all the money including baggage and taxes etc.
reviews.author: Disco

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: It's a nightmare. If you want to be stressed out to the maximum with rules that make no sense and are not properly disclosed with zero customer service and then forced to comply and pay additional charges only to arrive late then this is the airline for you. Let's start with normal which is arrive about an 90 minutes before you flight leaves. Now if your flight is delayed three hours what time should you arrive. Well this airline will cancel your ticket if you don't arrive an hour before the originally scheduled flight not withstanding that plane isn't going anywhere for hours. Worse if you have a completely changeable ticket and you arrive 30 minutes before original scheduled depart and four hours before actual departs your ticket becomes non cancelable and non changeable without payment of the full change fee. Which will likely exceed the cost of buying a new flight. So after you pay for the next flight then you loose your seat selection and your carry on bags. I got a notice the next flight was delayed over an hour but they want you to board on time to just sit on the airplane. Essentially I lost one full day of my trip and my life. It took me about nine hours to take a one hour flight plus almost double what I initially paid. Don't fall for the cheap price. They will get you with hidden charges and rules. This was my second time flying this airline. The first time was even worse.
reviews.author: zachary z

reviews.title: Scam artists
reviews.text: Do not book this airline…. They don’t have ANYONE in customer service. I don’t think they even have a customer service department…. They don’t give refunds or care that you got screwed…
reviews.author: Davidoff1982

reviews.title: TERRIBLE OVERBOOKING BY 48 PEOPLE
reviews.text: I would not recommend this company they are absolutely cowboys when it comes to their competition, managed to ruin my best friends STAG do due to overbooking the plane by 48 passengers. So it meant that only 6 out of the group managed to get on the plane when I booked / made the arrangements over 4 months ago. There solution was to offer a flight at 8pm that night to Paris and then stop over for 7 hours to then get a flight which wasn't and isn't acceptable at all! Like I said do not use this company unless you like stress, disappointment and a general feeling of sadness
reviews.author: Nathan P

reviews.title: Ansolute worst. Criminal.
reviews.text: They will cancel your flights. They will lose your luggage. And they will do nothing about it. Be prepared to make repeated calls, be answered by robots, and when you finally get through to a human being, that human being will be nonchalant, and hang up on you. Never ever fly with them.
reviews.author: Samuel P

reviews.title: Avoid this airline
reviews.text: Shocking service. Avoid this airline. Two weeks in a row I booked the 14:10 flight 19th and 26th June 2023) Both times the airline changed it to 19:15. I checked in online both times. Each time boarding was delayed. Then, both times, every person that had checked in online was not actually checked-in in the system. This meant that boarding gate staff had to manually re-check in every such person and issue them a paper ticket. Both flights eventually arrived in Barcelona after midnight compared to 17:25 per the original booking. Reason for delay; technical issues. You can say that again, but not to me. I won’t be there.
reviews.author: Malcolm B

reviews.title: THE WORST TRAVEL EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: do NOT fly Vueling. The absolute, worst customer service. The phone lines, if you can actually get through to talking to an agent because it is a robot, keeps directing you to go online, but it is just a robot chat service. I once was hung up on by a customer service agent, when I was in the airport due to a delay, the agent didn't even see, or know that there was a delay. It is a completely inadequate airline. They lost my check in bag and have not helped me at all find its location. I am now in a battle to be refunded and compensated for missing my other connecting flights to the US because of their error.
reviews.author: samarashoo

reviews.title: Worst airline ever flown with
reviews.text: This is without a doubt the worst airline I’ve ever flown with. I had a morning flight from Gatwick to Barcelona when at the boarding gate I showed them my ticket and they said to each other she doesn’t have a seat to which I was like not sure what you mean there is a seat number on my ticket they then just asked me to wait at the side. A few more passengers tried to board also asked to wait to the side then heard them say because of emergency exits on the plane not working we would not be able to board the plane. Approximately 60 passengers not allowed to Board. There was zero communication between staff and passengers for over an hour and when they was asked what was happening for any sort of clarity they would say sorry we don’t know right now just bare with us. Then they said there was other flights that day one at 1300 one at 1530 1740 and 2100 but the only flight we could get on was 2100. This was a significant delay from the 0900 flight that morning. There was no food vouchers or any compensations that day. When asked could they get another plane or put us on another flight which they aid we don’t do that. As the 2100 flight would get me too late into Barcelona and as a women travelling on her own getting on public transport at close to 0100 wouldn’t be an option so had to book a flight for next morning where I lost a whole day of my holiday
reviews.author: Clare H

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Flight time changed over 6 times and the final time they decided on was too early/optimistic. They had everyone stand and wait in line for an hour before boarding. No updates on when we will board. No one to talk to because no one is at the counter. No one knows what to do or what’s happening. Hope the pilot is better than the service. At this point the passengers have stood in line longer than they would have seated on the plane flight.
reviews.author: Brian L

reviews.title: Worst Airlines -Bad costumer service
reviews.text: Worst experience I ever had with costumer services. My flight from Barcelona to LCA on the 19th of June got cancelled and Vueling provided me with the option of either get a refund or change the flight. As ALL the flights from Barcelona to Larnaca were cancelled in June I left with no option but proceed with refund. I got the email that it will take up to 7 working days to get the refund. Later on I got an email saying that I got flight credit which means that Vueling is keeping the money and I can use them for a different flight something that I did NOT asked. IT IS IMPOSSIBLE TO CONTACT THEM, I contacted the BCN airport they couldn't help ,I used the online chat on their website which both times all of a sudden I had "poor connection" when I asked for the refund. We only exchanged few emails telling me the same thing again and again in regards to flight credit. TERRIBLE
reviews.author: NIKOLETTA M

reviews.title: Atrocious Customer Service - Avoid this Airline
reviews.text: By far the worst customer service I've ever experienced. An infinite loop between a useless "virtual assistaint", website and the phone service. Hours waiting and stuck on a loop with the phone robots, always missing the option to talk to someone about the actual problem you have. They offer only the options that you could sue them for if they hadn't. Again, atrocious. If you have any issues with your booking expect to be charged even for looking at it.
reviews.author: Albert C

reviews.title: The worst airline company
reviews.text: The worst airline company ever. I will proceed with legal actions against it. I was trying to do online check in the day before and they didn’t allow me. Arriving to the airport 2.5 hours before the flight. The screen was showing wrong numbers for the desk to check in. I was waiting 45 minutes in a wrong desk. Then I had to go to another desk waiting for another 30 minutes to check in. Being in the desk 1 hour and 1 minute before the flight. And the girl there told me to go to the another desk which is last minute. Then I went there waiting 3-4 minutes. Then the girl there told me that the flight was closed because I am late one minute. The check in is closed one hour before the flight apperantly 🤷‍♂️. Then she told me to go and buy another ticket for the next flight. Paying 2 times more agin of the actual ticket, costs me 125 euros extra. They use such manipulating tactics. I will do everything in my power to close this airline company.
reviews.author: Marios G

reviews.title: Website forced you to pay for 2 cabin bag if you are 2 pp even if you only have 1 luggage to add
reviews.text: There website won't allow to pay for 1 extra cabin luggage if you are 2 persons. But you are force to pay for 2 extra luggage. If you dont pay for 2 luggage even if you have 1 , they charged me 50€ for 1 luggage. Seriously Rip off website system, I would not have complained if they made it clear that wether you adding one or 2 luggage it's minimum 50€.
reviews.author: THE C

reviews.title: Delayed and then told the flight was overbooked
reviews.text: I got to the airport more than 2 hours ahead of the scheduled departure time and was told the flight was overbooked despite checking in. When boarding was annouced, I wasn't allocated a seat. Though I was a single woman travelling alone, I was told I would be compensated and was assigned a flight that was taking off 12 hours later on the next afternoon. I was made to wait more than 2 hours after the flight's departure before they assigned a hotel for me to stay the night. Extremely poor management. I'm astonished that they can still overbook a flight in this day and age. I won't be flying Vueling again. Ever.
reviews.author: Eunice D

reviews.title: What a joke
reviews.text: No gate number till last minute Loading passengers they had no idea On a 6 week holiday No bags turned up at Venice. 7 days later still No bags, contacted vueling No interest whatsoever The couldn't care less, the staff hung up on our calls many times, we have sent emails and too many calls still No response.ANOTHER 5 WEEKS TO GO WITH NO LLUGGAGE VUELING ARE A DISGRACE AND HAVE NO CARE, PLEASE STEER CLEAR.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.title: Fine low price carrier
reviews.text: Fine trip where you get your money worth. Service minded staff and good boarding procedure, though some passengers were quite undisciplined and rude when disembarking.
reviews.author: LarsBA

reviews.title: Worst Airline Ever
reviews.text: Hard to believe one company could have so many rude, arrogant, ignorant and lazy employees. Rating this airline a one is overly generous Don't make the mistake of booking a flight with this worthless airline. If you do, you will regret it!
reviews.author: Donn M

reviews.title: Worsted Airlines I have ever seen in my life
reviews.text: I had purchased ticket through there website and had done the check in also, while reached to the airport with boarding pass, they didn't allow me to board, they said booking cancelled, again next day booked & reached but same, they not allow me to board,showing booking cancelled, without any prior notice. so don't book vueling airlines.
reviews.author: Sakib U

reviews.title: Absolutely NOT possible to get in touch with Vueling!!!!
reviews.text: They charged me for seat reservation AND € 1 extra for my luggage at the check out (2x € 38 = €79 ???) BUT I was not allowed to seat in my seat and had to change it because I was travelling with my dog which they knew from the beginning! Now I seem to have received an email which I never did and it is simply impossible for me to get in touch with Vueling. Even I send them a few new messages through the robot they simply do not respons. This new way of working & mindset, this way of inhumanly approach to people is just lowest of the low!
reviews.author: Sheida70

reviews.title: First and.....last!
reviews.text: Awful!. Booked via 3rd party website. Problems with tickets at check in - would not accept although clearly visible on their computer that they had Overbooked, which seems a regular occurrence. Problems on board with seat allocation and customer demanding his seat when already occupied. Eventually I think someone was paid off to vacate their seat and leave, meaning flight delayed and slot missed. Flight attendants had no idea what was going on, airport security on board, seats counted 4 times and still no idea.. Standby passengers then boarded! Overloaded with screaming kids! Very little food on offer, only Becks beer, no tea, no crisps, close to zero. All in all I suppose you get what you pay for and this was a cheap flight. I should have read reviews prior to booking. As the song goes "...things can only get better" - but I won't hold my breath
reviews.author: TonyP1

reviews.title: Overbooked flight
reviews.text: 13/06/2023 To whom it may concern, My wife and I have just completed a month in Europe. Portugal, Spain, Gibralter, Prague and Venice. We are leaving Venice and flying to Barcelona on your airline for our last leg back to the states. We had tickets that were purchased months ago and arrived for our 9:40 AM flight to Barcelona flight VY6401 where my wife and I were to celebrate our 46th wedding anniversary for our last night in Europe. That all changed when we were told we couldn’t get our tickets because the flight was overbooked. The agent at the gate said we would have to wait until the boarding process was complete to see if there were available seats. When I asked her why the plane was overbooked she told me that they can book flights 10% over capacity. And there was nothing more they could do. Well there were not enough extra seats to allow us on the flight. My Grandson and Daughter-in-law had to fly on without us. Our only option was to get booked on a flight at 10:10 at night flight VY6405. So much for a nice anniversary and end to our trip. We were given $250 Euro and food vouchers for compensation for being denied boarding but that was no concelation for what we missed. I would just like to express my disappointment on how you conduct business and will definitely review and post our experience about your company. I sincerely hope that this letter will reach someone of importance so they can try and keep this from happening to future travelers and not someone who will just read it and delete it. Sincerely Timothy Gray
reviews.author: Tfgray

reviews.title: Terrible service - disaster
reviews.text: For no sake fly with this company - Vueling. The lady working on the Tenerife Airport check in desk was super friendly, however she told me I can check in with the connecting flight to Ibiza on the embarkation desk in Malaga Airport which was denied to me and I could not board the connecting flight. The personal in Malaga was totally ignorant and helpless. There was no aim for recontribution or finding an alternative solution to help me land in the destination.
reviews.author: Jan F

reviews.title: The worst customer service in the world
reviews.text: The title sums it up really, i'll never book with them ever again and I would strongly suggest you don't either. 1 - it is basically impossible to speak to someone unless you press the options to get through to sales (choose a new booking) 2 - they refuse to help in any circumstances, their default and only answer is no. avoid, avoid, avoid
reviews.author: Heavy Tedz

reviews.title: Vueling is the worst airline I have ever flown.   Avoid it at all costs!
reviews.text: Vueling Airlines should not be in business! Avoid taking Vueling. The flight arrived 30 mins ate and our bags were 45 mins late. We missed our connection and we were forced to buy another full fare at $1800, because Vueling was not connected to our other flight we missed. They said they are an independent airline that doesn't connect to any other airline. We were also forced to pay $400 in bags because they don't allow carry on unless it's tiny. What thieves!! They also were unfriendly, rude and wouldn't listen to our complaint. They just said to go on line and file a complaint. Well, guess what, surprise, surprise, their on line complaint or claims doesn't work. It keeps saying to try later. This was the worst experience we have ever had with any airlines. Never have we been treated so poorly and no one would help. Hard lesson to learn. Stay away from Vueling Airlines. They are terrible. We went through hell just to get home. We lost a lot of time and money. We ended up not sleeping for 27 hours. It was horrible... because of Vueling's late flight and late bag arrival. If I could give them a big fat ZERO, that's what I would have rated them. They are crooks!!
reviews.author: Olympia Zellmer

reviews.title: A budget airline? A racket airline is what it is!
reviews.text: Deceptive practices is the best description for this airline. I will never use it again, that is for sure. I purchased a ticket, and later I paid extra to bring the carry-on in the cabin. When I did the check-in, the attendant was ok with the size of my suitcase, which followed the guidelines listed on their website, both in size and weight. However, when I tried to board, I was told that it needed to fit the contraption they have for a much smaller bag. When I tried to explain that I had paid extra to bring the suitcase with me in the cabin, they said it did not matter, nor would they apply that charge to the 120 euros I had to pay extra to check-in the bag. When I tried to protest, their attitude was "there is nothing you can do." They also make you wait until the last minute, so you have no choice. In the meantime, there was an empty seat next to mine which the person seated at the aisle used to occupy with her very oversized bag. In addition, the food that was warmed for the passengers who ill-chose to buy in the plane smelled rotten!
reviews.author: Paris1004

reviews.title: Overbooking
reviews.text: I had booked a return flight to Malaga so that I could have a brief period of recovery before having radiotherapy for cancer. Apparently they were overbooked by 6 people. Some seats were already taken but there were 2 left. I explained to the woman at the gate why I needed a break. But a couple appeared after me and were allotted the seats. I was told I couldn’t fly until at least the next day and even then it was overbooked. Why do they overbook ? A member of staff told me it happens all the time. I was just pointed to leave and had to walk a long way to get back to their desk which wasn’t attended to. Eventually a long escorted trip through customs/ passport again then a very long wait for their rep- then I was told there was only one and he was out of the country. Finally I gave up and had to go home. Such an upsetting experience and unnecessary. If they didn’t overbook this need not have happened. A thoroughly difficult and upsetting experience.
reviews.author: Suzanne P

reviews.title: AVOID! Do not fly with these people
reviews.text: So firstly we had a flight to Paris on the way out here delayed on Friday from 12:45pm to then be 3:30 in the U.K to then finally take off which was okay but to basically ruin a day of activities that I had planned with my girlfriend on the Friday. After this we was waiting for our flight home last night to London Gatwick where our flight was meant to be at 6:55pm for them to be delayed all the way till 8:30pm to finally board the plane then we was all sat on the plane for 2 hours with no ac for then the pilot to finally bring the courage to tell the everyone the flight was cancelled and that his computer wasn’t working which is just absurd as he would of done multiple checks before this before the flight as you would before any flight then we had to go back through customs again like as if we just landed in France to then being told to go to terminal 1 in a massive cue full of angry customers and 1 guy dealing with it all but some of the people on our flight had no money and was told to book a hotel a taxi and another flight or wait another day and half for a next flight which is just crazy how is anyone supposed to be told all this at 1 am in the morning honestly never experienced anything like this but it was just minimum support from a so called big airline if they have any sense they should be supporting every customer on this flight as myself and my girlfriend now have had to book a hotel another flight from another airport as there is none coming from our airport no more is just crazy! AVOID AVOID AVOID!
reviews.author: Joe B

reviews.title: Please do not choose them because they are cheap, even easy jet or Ryanair is better choice than Vueling
reviews.text: My flight was delayed then canceled, no compensation at all, booger night hotel, nobody came to help us. And this is the only airline you can not find custom service, they tried everything to deny your request.
reviews.author: Angela

reviews.title: Despite all the negative reviews, I fly anyway
reviews.text: Had a pleasant flight with Vueling, we were delayed by 30 minutes, but that time flew past when I got talking to a local tour guide next to me. Just a reminder that most people don’t tell you about their good experiences on here, only the negative. I would recommend this airline.
reviews.author: Mikaela S

reviews.title: Boarding denied Munich>Barcelona jun 17th 2023
reviews.text: Lady at the counter denied the entrance to 4 passengers claiming that they took a too Long time at the restroom. She saw the people running towards the gate and yielled at them that it was too late and closed the stripe right before they were going to pass. This is by far the worst customer service I had ever witnessed. The lady yelled for 20minutes more amd even the captain came out to ask what happened and still denied the boarding to these passengers. Make sure you never use this airline!!
reviews.author: Fernando M

reviews.title: Rude staff! Small airplane, no space! Awful experience!!!!
reviews.text: I flew with Vueling on the 8th of June to Seville - Spain. My husband and I, arrived on time at the airport and we went to drop the luggage. Needless to say, that we had already checked in online beforehand, we had our Boarding passes done and we just wanted to drop the luggage. So... we walked through a few self check in machines (a guy was there but he didn't even say "hi"...let along to give us directions...) We walked towards the luggage drop area, we put our luggage on the belt, the belt pulled our luggage in and then out again. That happened a couple of times, and that rude short guy told us that we should go to check in at the shelf machines. We told him that we had already checked in but he insisted, so that we could have the sticker on the luggage! I said "Bloody Hell! So why no one told us that we should do this before?" And he said in a sarcastic and rude way "yes sir...bloody hell... you should have done this before you come to drop the luggage" We went back to the machine, checked AGAIN in and we finally got the sticker for the luggage. He was looking at us and then he started a chit chat with others, looking at us and laughing.. Funny fact....we were supposed to celebrate my birthday; hence the trip to Seville... This rude, awful, unprofessional and unacceptable attitude guy had already destroyed everything. Thank you Vueling... Next time I think I prefer to swim rather than get a ticket from you. You should be ashamed having these people working for you. Awful! Regarding the flight.... Awfully small seats, no leg room, not space... uncomfortable trip... I mean... Nope...
reviews.author: Paris V

reviews.title: Overbooked flight- DO NOT USE!
reviews.text: Absolutely dreadful service- do not use!! 6 of us were flying to Barcelona for a hen do for the weekend. We were unable to check in online and advised we could at the airport, couldn't use the machines so went to the desk. The flight was heavily overbooked and we were advised it was 50/50 if we would get on, we had all paid and booked our tickets over 6 months ago which was just ridiculous (told they were 46 seats overbooked, we clearly were not going to get on.) We got to the gate, as anticipated we did not get on. They let half of another hen group on, none of ours for some inexplicable reason. We were advised vueling decided the order of the chosen few who got on with no further explanation in spite of repeatedly asking if we could at least get our hen on and the rest would wait. We were then kept waiting around for a few hours, to be 'decontrolled' back into departures. Just an absolute nightmare on what should have been a really exciting trip. We were advised we would get on a flight that day, but no guarantees which one. The latest being over 12 hours later than our original flight time. The company knew they were heavily overbooked 2 days before, they could easily have informed us in advance and reallocated the seats. Yes this would have been annoying however it would have saved the extreme stress and upset to us all and us waiting at the airport for 6 hours. We missed our booked evening hen activities and it ruined the trip losing us a days holiday. It was chaos, eventually telling us the group would be split so some would be 6 hours late and some 8., another poor group had to wait 10 hours. On the way back, we were advised the same. Overbooked, may not get on, would have to go to the gate and see. We did on the way back, however again causing us huge stress. Do not use them, absolutely useless, not worth the stress, I have never experienced such dreadful customer service.
reviews.author: Catherine P

reviews.title: baggage rip off and rude staff!!
reviews.text: My family and I were at the airport 3 hours before our flight. Stood in line for an hour and a half to check in our bags, only to be ripped off when we were charged for our handluggage 50€ each (the ones that were supposed to be included). After looking it up, we found out this airline is know for ripping people off! Next we went to security and after we stood in line for 40 min and were next up, the staff very rudely pointed and pushed us to go down the hallway to a much longer line. Keep in mind, we had two toddlers in our arms!!! When I asked the staff why they put us in a much longer line, when it was finally our turn and that we could miss our flight, she screamed in my face that it goes to the same place...when I tried to explain that we were up next before and this line was much longer, she stormes off. We had to wait in that line for another 20 min. Worst airline we have ever traveled with. We almost missed our flight because of this and they told us it was our fault even though we had screaming kids in our arms and ran straight from the security to the gate. Stay away from this airline! Would give them a zero if I could.
reviews.author: Rakel K

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I had spent 10 days in the Algarve. We flew there with TAPortugal, hand luggage + backpack were included in the ticket price + an additional suitcase as checked baggage. I knew that our return flight would be with Vueling, but I hadn't really thought about it... Our flight was on a Saturday, I wanted to check in the day before on Friday. Already on the check-in screen in the app, I was informed by an orange-colored warning that no hand luggage was included in the booking. When booking the flight back then, this was not apparent. So I proceeded with the check-in without additionally paying for the hand luggage. After a few hours, I couldn't get rid of the queasy feeling in my stomach and finally booked the hand luggage with our boarding pass. That was €62 per person. I was also forced to reserve a seat for a fee when checking in online. So in the end I paid about 150€ more in total. On the day of departure, we arrived in Faro at the airport. There were only two check-in counters at Vueling, there wasn't even a pure baggage drop-off line, so why should I check in online if I have to queue? In addition, progress was slow, as all passengers naturally discussed the additional cost of hand luggage. When we finally made it onto the plane, my friend and I immediately noticed that the plane hadn't been cleaned. Dirt, leftover food and other rubbish from weeks was clearly visible on the floor (video available) and crumbs and grease stains on the seats. If you can avoid this airline, believe me, do it. In general, I'd rather pay a little more for my flight than get ripped off afterwards.
reviews.author: Fabienne G.

reviews.title: Rip off luggage
reviews.text: Party of three adults and two children travelling to Disneyland. Going was fine Boarded plane with no problems whatsoever all had hand luggage under 10kg. Coming home however we where told we had to pay for hand luggage at 55 euros a bag, crazy that we can take a 10 kg rucksack on free but have to pay for a 10kg cabin bag which was free on way out. When we questioned it they said don’t pay you don’t fly and when we asked to see a manager they accused us of taking pictures (which we never) then would not check us in and kept us waiting for ages with a 3 and 4 year olds before it was sorted and we could check in again which meant we had to rush to make the gate . Whether this is the airlines philosophy or the the French staffs philosophy only you can decide but I will not be using them again as the attitude stinks.
reviews.author: Geoff

reviews.title: They cancelled my ticket and didn't tell me
reviews.text: I went to the airport to check-in for my flight only to find out that the airline had cancelled my ticket without telling me--no email, no text message, nothing. The check-in agent called to see why it was cancelled and I was told "missing security information". I checked my spam folder to verify that no message was ever sent. I could find no way to actually call the airline, of course. I spent $400 and a train trip to Barcelona to get a flight out that day. I checked my credit card and saw that they had credited my account with the amount of the ticket purchase, minus a few dollars.
reviews.author: Sidney H

reviews.title: Lost Luggage, Terrible Customer Service
reviews.text: Lost my luggage due to their employee's negligence (forgot to print a luggage tag), it's been five weeks and still they haven't done jack other than respond to my emails by telling me they are "looking into" the issue. I haven't even gotten a straight, consistent answer from their terrible customer service into whether they actually ever even looked for it. I didn't even want to check the bag but they refused to allow me to carry it on despite it being well under the size and weight limits Seriously, I cannot stress this enough, DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY
reviews.author: Zoe G

reviews.title: Could have been a five
reviews.text: After reading the awful Vueling reviews I was really sceptical about flying with them - not my choice, a Tui city break but not a Tui flight! Smooth check-in at Edinburgh, good flight, friendly and efficient cabin crew. Barcelona airport at 5am a nightmare, the desks allocated for Edinburgh flight were for self serve, myself and other passengers unable to do this, kept coming up passport expired talk to advisor. Only one person in sight being bombarded with same query, pointed us all to check in desks with ground staff - well over an hour from airport entry to dropping off suitcase. Flight back to Edinburgh all good, so Vueling get 4 stars for flights and zero for Barcelona Airport baggage drop off.
reviews.author: Alison W

reviews.title: can’t check in because you must pay for the seats!!
reviews.text: This is a joke. The site forces you to pay for a seat if you don’t you must go to the airport early and check in by the counter. ?! Are we back in 2002? This is outrageous. And the seat prices were 44 and 16.
reviews.author: Reka

reviews.title: Do not Fly!!
reviews.text: Do not fly!! It'a simple advice as far as Vueling is concerned. It is nothing more than a flying piece of sh** stinking all around. Had a terrible experience at Rome flying to Barcelona with Vueling on 03rd June 2023. Everything about this airline - staff attitude and negligence, luggage rules, (lack of!) punctuality is below standard. Vueling just there to suck money out of you in every possible way. Ended Rome Barcelona trip with a bitter experience and extra 100 Euro out of pocket for no acceptable reason. STAY AWAY FROM VUELING! It's simply not worth it for any fare! There's nothing good about Vueling. You've been warned!
reviews.author: Nadeer K
